title: Require Service Proof Isolation
forbids: standalone service production source that statically imports, re-exports, dynamically imports, requires, or resolves a literal relative module source beneath its own package-root test directory
why: Package-root service proof may consume production behavior, but production source must not acquire proof fixtures, harnesses, or suites. Keeping the edge one-way preserves the production boundary without inventing a service-test alias lane.
remediate: Move proof-only code under the package-root test tree and keep production dependencies under src. Remove the relative edge from production source; do not replace it with an alias to proof code.
message: Standalone service production source must not import package proof code.
